title: Features
description: What ATHA does, and what it deliberately does not do.

items.title: Guided breathing sessions
items.summary: Inhale, hold, exhale and hold-out guided by ambient visuals, haptics and sound.

items.title: Custom breathing patterns
items.summary: Build your own timing. Any phase can be set to zero if you do not want it.

items.title: Ambient breathing visuals
items.summary: Orb, aurora, liquid, flower, ripple, wave, particle and glow — all driven by the same breathing state.

items.title: Routines and reminders
items.summary: Schedule a practice and let a local reminder bring you back to it.

items.title: The Garden
items.summary: Your cumulative practice grows a scene from seed to forest. A metaphor, not a claim.

items.title: Insights and records
items.summary: Mindful minutes, streaks, completion rate, calendar history and your own effective practices.

items.title: Apple Health
items.summary: Optional Mindful Sessions and State of Mind entries. Core breathing never requires Health access.

items.title: Widgets, Watch and Shortcuts
items.summary: Start a session from the Home Screen, your wrist, or a Siri shortcut.

items.title: Themes and appearance
items.summary: System, light and dark, plus palettes that recolour visuals, glow and ambience.

items.title: On-device by design
items.summary: No ATHA cloud account for your breathing history. Analytics are anonymous and can be turned off.

items.title: Free, with no ads
items.summary: The whole app, at no cost. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no advertising, no account.
